properties.name: Every served tool's description is accurate about what the tool actually does — its behaviour, its reply shape, and what an empty answer means
properties.statement: Anthony, 2026-09-11, stating the success criteria for the tool-sweep effort: "that each tool description is accurate about what it actually does". A tool's served description shall let a consumer predict what the tool returns, including what an empty or zero result means, before calling it. Measured 2026-09-11 by predicting each tool's behaviour from its served text and then calling it: 13 of 37 blind-scored read-only tools scored MISS or PARTIAL — hierarchy_issues (8 words, indistinguishable clean from vacuous), dimension_drift (`{"value":null}` on a legal call), propose_allocation (238 clusters from one edge with no warning), describe_designs (reports a verified-absent path as `opted_in`), reconcile_dependencies (says "the build agrees" when no build was observed), compose_and_analyse (empty seam on a purpose-built one). Those thirteen are the initial acceptance list; the description-vs-behaviour prediction test is the method.
